## Strategic Plan 2026-2028

Board approved - confidential

## 1. Vision

By 2028 Halvorsen Industrial Systems will be the most reliable European supplier of engineered pumping systems, with recurring service and digital revenue representing 25% of group sales.

## 2. Financial targets

Targets approved by the Board in November 2025.

| Year | Revenue | Adj. EBITDA margin | Headcount |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2026 | EUR 438m | 15.2% | 4,050 |
| 2027 | EUR 476m | 16.0% | 4,180 |
| 2028 | EUR 521m | 17.1% | 4,300 |

## 3. Strategic initiatives

Initiative 1 - SmartFlow digital services: owner Ritva Soininen, budget EUR 9.5m, target 4,000 connected pumps by 2027.

Initiative 2 - Footprint optimisation: owner Ilari Pesonen, consolidate machining from Brno into Gdansk Assembly by Q2 2027, saving EUR 6.1m per year.

Initiative 3 - Nordic growth: owner Jarmo Pesonen, open Stockholm sales office and grow Nordic revenue by 40%.

Initiative 4 - Project Nordlys: owner Maria Peltoniemi, bolt-on acquisition in valve automation (see confidential memo).

Initiative 5 - Talent: owner Petteri Hartikainen, reduce voluntary attrition from 9.8% to below 7%.

## 4. Risks

Principal risks: energy price volatility, dependence on two casting suppliers, cyber risk to OT networks, and integration risk on acquisitions. Mitigations are owned by the executive team and reviewed quarterly.
